title: Revert "Qt: Add Find in Packet search feature"
description:
This reverts commit b8eced2ebabb1192ecb8f843cad83c1b1d43135b

Not ready yet for 4.7.0 release

notes.body: Several problems with Stratoshark, plus the comments from Stig (https://gitlab.com/wireshark/wireshark/-/merge_requests/25004#note_3393113460).  This is just too close to the 4.7.0 release to have it included.

changes_data.diff:
@@ -65,9 +65,6 @@ The following features are either new or have been significantly updated since v
 
 * The RTP Player now supports AMR-WB encoded audio.
 
-* A "Find in Packet" search bar has been added to the packet details pane.
-  It can be opened via the Edit menu, the toolbar, or the shortcut Ctrl+Shift+F, enabling filtering, highlighting, and navigation of protocol fields within the selected packet.
-
 * The protocol dissection API has been updated to more safely handle packet data offsets and lengths.
   See the <<Major API Changes>> section below for details.
